name: Open-NCR refusal of traveler completion
description: One refusal shape returned by every code path that can move a traveler to 'submitted for completion' (1.5) or 'completed' (2) while any linked NCR is not Closed (spec FR-013 to FR-016). Produced by lib/traveler-ncr.js assertNoOpenNcrs(); the four call sites below all return it unchanged. No role, including administrators and managers, bypasses it (FR-015).

applies_to.when: req.body.status is 1.5 or 2 (after the existing transition and authorization checks, before the save)
body.status parses to 1.5 or 2; checked before updateTravelerStatus runs (whose case 2 accepts 1 -> 2 directly)

the document is a Traveler and the result is an approval (result == '1'). Checked BEFORE the reviewer's result is recorded, so a refused approval leaves the review state untouched and can be retried once the NCRs close.

body.message: This traveler cannot be completed while 2 linked NCRs are not Closed.

open_ncrs.status: string — one of Submitted | Dispositioned | Approval Requested | Returned for Comment | Final Approval
open_ncrs.input_name: string | null — null for a legacy link with no input

client_behaviour.public/javascripts/traveler.js setStatus: On 409 with code OPEN_NCRS render an alert listing each NCR as a link (prefix + '/ncrs/' + ncr_id) with its status and input label. Build with DOM/.text(); never concatenate response text into HTML. Other failures keep the existing 'Cannot change the status: ...' text.
client_behaviour.public/javascripts/traveler.js complete: Re-enable the form inputs it disabled before calling setStatus(1.5) when the request fails.
client_behaviour.public/javascripts/traveler.js submitRev: Add a failure handler; show the same message for a refused approval (today the call has only a success handler).

not_refused: 1 -> 1.5 or 1.5 -> 2 when every linked NCR is Closed, or the traveler has none (spec FR-016; the traveler's other completion rules are unchanged)
